The '''Anorelga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the northern part of the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]], within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Anorelgan slip-socker]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Anorelgan slip-socker]]|system=Anorelga [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> an item that was being sold during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Anorelga system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-3.<ref name="TEA" />
